verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity verification flows offer a static link that can be reused to verify any number of users. That covers the core of sending a verification by link without building a per-session API integration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of no-code flow creation in the Dashboard, any QR-code delivery option, and independent hands-on corroboration of ops teams using static links for one-off verifications.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller

citations.quote: You can use a flow’s static link to verify any number of your users.
Flows provide a way to save and reuse the same configuration across all of your integration interfaces.
